viral_video_formula.drop_timing: 4.0s - 6.0s (Audio drop snaps directly to primary combat impact / technique activation)
viral_video_formula.framing: 1080x1920 (9:16 portrait) with centered 16:9 widescreen letterbox (656px black bars top & bottom)
viral_video_formula.audio_mix: 85% driving Phonk BGM (volume 1.25) / 15% subtle anime combat SFX (volume 0.30, 80Hz HPF, 12kHz LPF), zero voice cutoffs
viral_video_formula.color_grading: S-curve contrast (1.35-1.45), vivid character energy accents, subtle unsharp sharpen (1.2-1.3), vignette PI/3.8
viral_video_formula.universe_isolation: 100% strict single-universe content. Never mix JJK and Demon Slayer audio, video, or metadata.
